description: Fresh comparison-suite policies; exact frozen executable bytes and original scored outcomes.

memory.name: stage
memory.description: cue | approach | press

memory.name: ball_xy
memory.description: world xy of the ball averaged over cue frames (front RGB-D)

memory.name: ball_obs
memory.description: number of cue frames in which the ball was measured

memory.name: cups
memory.description: cup top-centre xy measured when the cups appeared

memory.name: target_xy
memory.description: xy used as the target cup reference (ball xy)

memory.name: cup_top
memory.description: measured cup top height in metres

memory.name: frames_seen
memory.description: observed frames so far (native steps + reset frame)

memory.name: cue_frames
memory.description: frames with ball visible and no cups

memory.name: contact_step
memory.description: frame count when the TCP landed on the cup

memory.name: notes
memory.description: diagnostics about target selection

memory.name: target
memory.description: target disc centre [x, y] (world m) from front RGB-D ring pixels; static, fixed once a complete detection (>=500 px) is seen

memory.name: target_px
memory.description: pixel count of the target detection kept in memory (detection quality)

memory.name: track
memory.description: free-rolling ball detections [step, x, y] before contact (last 25), used for the straight-line fit

memory.name: post
memory.description: ball detections [step, x, y] after the planned/observed contact (diagnostics)

memory.name: contact_dy
memory.description: chosen contact offset: ball is met at y = target_y - contact_dy (m); re-chosen until contact is < 8 steps away

memory.name: contact_step
memory.description: frozen (fractional) native step at which the ball reaches the contact point; null before

memory.name: contact_point
memory.description: frozen ball-centre contact point [x, y] on its fitted line

memory.name: stage
memory.description: approach | contact | early_contact (ball left its line before the planned contact)

memory.name: first_step
memory.description: step index of the first observed frame (phase-time origin)

memory.name: last_step
memory.description: last frame step folded into memory (makes updates idempotent)

memory.name: off_count
memory.description: consecutive ball detections off the predicted line (2 near the paddle -> early contact; 2 far -> track reset)

memory.name: notes
memory.description: last anomaly message (e.g. ball off predicted line)

memory.name: decisions
memory.description: number of decisions taken

memory.name: stage
memory.description: observe | touch | probe: progress of the episode

memory.name: cue_rgb
memory.description: mean RGB [r,g,b] of the single cue cube seen before the delay (null until seen)

memory.name: cue_frames
memory.description: number of frames in which the single cue cube was seen

memory.name: cue_step
memory.description: native step of the first cue sighting

memory.name: response_step
memory.description: native step at which >=2 cubes first appeared (response phase start)

memory.name: cubes
memory.description: world xyz of every cube detected at response start (centre estimates)

memory.name: target
memory.description: world xyz of the cube whose colour matches the cue

memory.name: match_margin
memory.description: colour-distance margin between best and second-best cube (confidence)

memory.name: frames_seen
memory.description: latest native step already processed

memory.name: attempts
memory.description: number of act_touch calls issued (0 = primary centre touch next)

memory.name: log
memory.description: short note on how the target was chosen

memory.name: stage
memory.description: observe | wait_candidates | touch_<variant>: current stage of the episode

memory.name: cue_color
memory.description: colour of the single cue cube seen before the candidates appear

memory.name: cue_pixels
memory.description: front-camera pixel count of the cue cube (confidence)

memory.name: cue_step
memory.description: native step of the first cue observation

memory.name: cue_frames
memory.description: number of frames the cue colour was seen alone

memory.name: candidates
memory.description: color:x:y:z_top of every candidate cube in the first candidate frame

memory.name: candidates_step
memory.description: native step when >=2 cubes first appeared

memory.name: target_color
memory.description: colour of the chosen target cube

memory.name: target_xyz
memory.description: world centre estimate of the target cube (m)

memory.name: target_confidence
memory.description: matched (cue colour found) or guess

memory.name: steps_seen
memory.description: latest native step index observed

memory.name: touch_attempts
memory.description: number of act_touch calls issued

memory.name: history
memory.description: short log of stage transitions and act outcomes

memory.name: phase
memory.description: cue | delay | reach | pressing

memory.name: cue_color
memory.description: colour name of the single cue cube (empty until seen)

memory.name: cue_step
memory.description: first frame step at which the cue was seen (-1 unknown)

memory.name: cue_frames
memory.description: number of frames that confirmed the cue colour (confidence)

memory.name: cubes_step
memory.description: frame step at which the answer cubes appeared (-1 unknown)

memory.name: target_color
memory.description: colour of the cube chosen as target

memory.name: target_xy
memory.description: world xy of the target cube top-face centre

memory.name: cube_colors
memory.description: colours of the detected answer cubes

memory.name: cube_xy
memory.description: world xy of the detected answer cubes (same order)

memory.name: waits_for_target
memory.description: extra steps waited because the cue colour was not detected

memory.name: reach_calls
memory.description: number of reach/touch action calls

memory.name: notes
memory.description: diagnostic notes
